info.title: WIZER Data API
info.description: India-first news data: articles, AI tags, listed companies and story clusters. Never full article text. Private preview: the contract may change with 30 days' notice in the changelog.

get.description: Articles matching your filters, newest first, each with its story block. Plan: All plans.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords or a phrase in quotes. Matches title, description, summary and entities.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories, for example business,politics.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 639-1 codes, for example en,hi.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indian state named in the article, for example Maharashtra.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: NSE symbol, BSE code or ISIN. Comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Publisher ids, comma-separated, for example economictimes.indiatimes.com.

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: positive, neutral or negative.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earliest first_seen, ISO 8601. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Latest first_seen, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: story to embed the story block, or none.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Records per page, 1 to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

get.description: Publishers we cover, with languages, tier and type. Plan: All plans.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Records per page, 1 to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

link.description: Canonical publisher URL. The article body stays with the publisher.

description.description: The publisher's own meta description, at most 300 characters.

image_url.description: Lead image URL declared by the article page. We link to it and never re-host it.

video_url.description: Embedded video URL, when the page declares one.

creator.description: Named authors from the page's structured data. Desk and bureau bylines are dropped.

keywords.description: Publisher keywords, topped up with the article's leading entities.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code detected from the text: en, hi, and regional languages.

first_seen.description: When WIZER first saw the URL, UTC ISO 8601.

detection_lag_min.description: Minutes from pubDate to first_seen. Large for articles a publisher lists late.

source.description: id, name, domain, url, icon, tier (1 is the most-read) and type (news, wire, official, global).

ai_summary.description: One factual sentence written by WIZER's model from the article. Not publisher text.

category.description: One of 13 domains: business, politics, world, crime, sports, cricket, entertainment, health, education, environment, technology, crypto, general.

category_confidence.description: Model probability for the category, 0 to 1.

article_type.description: report, opinion, live_blog, press_release, analysis_explainer, digest or video_photo.

sensationalism.description: How sensational the framing is, 0 to 1.

entities.description: organizations, people and places named in the article.

geo.description: countries, Indian states and places named. States are resolved from cities and districts.

duplicate.description: True when the same publisher already ran this headline in the story.

wire_reprint.description: True for agency copy (PTI, ANI, IANS, UNI). Counted as amplification, not new reporting.

companies.description: Listed companies the article names: name, mention, nse_symbol, bse_code, isin, sector, industry.
